scripts.build: pnpm run build:chromium && pnpm run build:firefox
scripts.bundle:chromium: vite build && node ../../scripts/strip-manifest-key.mjs dist-chromium/manifest.json && rm -f bramble.zip && (cd dist-chromium && zip -rq ../bramble.zip . -x '*.d.ts' 'wasm/package.json' 'wasm/.gitignore' '*.DS_Store')
scripts.bundle:firefox: TARGET=firefox vite build && rm -f bramble-firefox.zip && (cd dist-firefox && zip -rq ../bramble-firefox.zip . -x '*.d.ts' 'wasm/package.json' 'wasm/.gitignore' '*.DS_Store')
